capabilities: Reorder list items by dragging their bullet, number, or checkbox markers
Move parent items together with contiguous nested list items
Reindent a moved subtree when dropped at a different nesting level
Cycle task types via a mobile toolbar command or Shift-click on desktop
Fade completed tasks and show partial parent task progress
extras: Only works in Live Preview; Reading view and Source mode are not draggable. Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later. Processes everything locally with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no built-in way to reorder list items by dragging, especially across nesting levels and on mobile.

relations.evidence: Cycle through Minimal-compatible task markers by Shift-clicking a checkbox on desktop.

summary: Drag-based list reordering for Live Preview, letting users move list items by dragging their bullet, number, or task checkbox markers.
